meta.title: Lease Loop
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Prices are today's list prices, net of VAT. Pick an item to choose your term and down payment.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.
condition.label: Condition
status.label: Status
contract.title: Signed contract
contract.rule: The net price locks when you sign, using the price list valid on the signing date. Earlier quotes are estimates. Later catalogue changes do not change your agreed net rent.
contract.error: Signing failed. Refresh to review the current price and availability, then try again.
contract.tax: VAT is added at the rate on each invoice date. A tax change can change your total while your net rent stays locked.
catalogue.noMatches: No items match these filters. Try removing one.
sort.name: Name: A to Z
filters.title: Filters
filters.termHint: Longer leases can lower the monthly rent on some items. The exact price is shown on the item page.
item.applyNote: Applying takes about 5 minutes. You will see your price again before you sign.
item.reserved: This item is reserved for another customer and cannot be leased right now.
item.notFound: We could not find this item.
lease.buyout: Buyout at the end of the lease: {amount}
lease.startsOn: Lease starting {date}. The price updates as you move the sliders.
lease.tooCheap: This item costs less than {min}, the smallest amount we can lease, so it cannot be leased.
lease.needsDown: We can finance at most {max}. This item needs a down payment of at least {down}.
lease.unavailable: We cannot price this lease. Try another term or down payment.
compare.toggle: Compare all terms side by side
compare.caption: The same item and down payment over each term
explain.title: Explain my price
explain.buyout: Buyout at the end of the term
explain.totalHint: Down payment plus {months} monthly rents, before VAT. Buying the item at the end is optional and not included.
explain.formula: Monthly rent = financed amount × monthly factor. The factor depends on the amount and the term, and already includes interest. Each amount is rounded once to the nearest cent; half a cent rounds up.
explain.vatChange: VAT is charged at the rate on each invoice date. It changes to {rate} % on {date}, so later invoices are higher even though your net rent stays the same.
explain.vatSame: VAT is charged at the rate on each invoice date.
catalogue.heading: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine
apply.deal: {months} months · {down} down payment · {monthly} per month with VAT
apply.changeNote: If you change an earlier answer, questions that no longer apply are removed automatically.
apply.removed: We removed answers that no longer apply: {questions}.
apply.listHint: One name per line. Leave empty if there are none.
apply.unavailable: We cannot start an application for this lease. Go back and choose the term and down payment again.
problem.empty: Please answer this question to continue.
problem.not_an_option: Please pick one of the options.
problem.bad_email: This does not look like an email address. Check for a missing @ or dot.
problem.bad_money: Please enter an amount in euros, for example 2 500 or 2 500,50.
problem.bad_business_id_check_digit: The last digit of this business ID does not match the others. Please check it for typos.
decision.title: Your application result
decision.approved.title: You are approved
decision.approved.text: Your monthly price is locked when you sign. You will see exactly what you pay before you sign.
decision.approved.signatory: Only an authorised signatory can make the contract binding, so we will send it to {email} to sign.
decision.declined.title: We cannot offer you a lease yet
decision.declined.sorry: We are sorry. You are welcome to keep looking around.
decision.manual.title: A person will check your application
decision.manual.text: Some applications are always checked by a person. This is normal and does not mean the answer is no. We will email you at {email} within 2 working days.
decision.changeLease: Change the term or down payment
reason.min_age: You need to be 18 or older on the day the lease starts. You are welcome to come back when you turn 18.
reason.residency: We can only lease to people who live in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
reason.affordability: The rent with VAT, {rent} a month, is more than 30 % of your monthly net income. Up to {max} a month would fit: a longer term or a down payment brings the rent down.
reason.business_id: The business ID does not pass the check-digit test.
reason.pep_manual_review: You told us that you or an owner is a politically exposed person. The law requires a person, not a rule, to check these applications.
reason.financed_below: The amount to finance is below {min}, the smallest lease we offer.
reason.financed_above: The amount to finance is above {max}, the largest lease we offer.
reason.other: One of your answers means we cannot offer a lease.
invoices.title: Monthly invoices
invoices.policy: Billed monthly in advance: the first invoice is dated and due on the lease start date. Full monthly rent applies even for mid-month starts. Short months use their last day, then return to the original day. Generation issues the complete schedule, including future invoices.
invoices.separate: Down payment and optional buyout are separate and excluded from these rental totals. VAT follows each invoice date.
signing.busy: Signing is in progress. Please wait.
signing.actor_required: Enter your name (1–100 characters, excluding surrounding spaces) to sign.
signing.invalid_down_payment: Enter a down payment in whole euro cents, between zero and the list price.
signing.below_minimum: The financed amount is below the minimum. Reduce the down payment or choose another item.
signing.above_maximum: The financed amount exceeds the maximum. Increase the down payment.
signing.unknown_asset: This item has no catalogue price. Choose another item.
signing.no_price_list_on_date: No price list applies on the signing date. Signing is unavailable.
signing.no_coefficient_on_date: No coefficient table applies on the signing date. Signing is unavailable.
signing.no_vat_on_date: No VAT rate applies on the signing date. Signing is unavailable.
signing.down_payment_negative: The down payment cannot be negative.
signing.down_payment_above_price: The down payment cannot exceed the list price.
signing.ready: Ready to sign. Review the price before signing.
sign.title: Review and sign
sign.lockedFrom: Locked price: {amount} net per month, from the price list dated {date}.
sign.listChangedLower: The price list changed after your quote on {quoted}. We always use the list that is valid on the day you sign, so your rent is {difference} a month lower than quoted.
sign.listChangedHigher: The price list changed after your quote on {quoted}. We always use the list that is valid on the day you sign, so your rent is {difference} a month higher than quoted. Please check it before you sign.
sign.listChangedSame: The price list changed after your quote on {quoted}, but the price of this item stayed the same.
sign.vatTitle: VAT is not part of the lock
sign.vatChange: VAT is charged at the rate on the day each invoice is issued. The rate is {now} % now and {next} % from {date}. Your net rent stays the same.
sign.vatSame: VAT is charged at the rate on the day each invoice is issued. It is {now} % now. Your net rent stays the same.
sign.agree: I have read the contract and I agree to it.
sign.noApplication: We could not find your answers in this browser. Please answer the application questions first.
sign.notApproved: This application is not approved, so it cannot be signed.
sign.signatoryOnly: Only {email} can sign for the company. We will send the contract to them to sign.
sign.unavailable: This lease cannot be signed right now. Go back and choose it again.
sign.error.PRICE_CHANGED: The price changed while this page was open. Reload the page to see the new price before you sign.
sign.error.ASSET_UNAVAILABLE: Someone else has just leased this item. Please choose another one.
sign.error.NOT_APPROVED: Your application is not approved, so it cannot be signed.
sign.error.SIGNATORY_REQUIRED: Only the company's authorised signatory can sign.
signIn.title: Welcome to Lease Loop
signIn.intro: This is a demo, so there is no password and no account. Just tell us what to call you.
signIn.label: Your name
signIn.problem.empty: Please enter a name to continue.
signIn.problem.too_long: Please use a shorter name, at most {max} characters.
signIn.privacy: We keep your name only until you close the browser.
signing.start_before_signing: The lease cannot start before the signing date.
sign.confirmRequired: Read and agree to the contract above to enable signing.
discount.policy: Only monthly net rent is discounted. Down payment and buyout stay unchanged; VAT is added afterwards.
discount.dealerPolicy: Choose your provider, then create a discount for longer rentals. Select the rental duration and percentage, then save.
discount.name: Rule name
discount.error: Could not save or load. Check the duration range and percentage, then reload to review any concurrent changes.
discount.noProviders: No dealer profiles are configured yet. Run npm run db:seed in the project terminal, then reload this page and choose Kettu Mobility Oy.
discount.ruleDetails: Rules apply to this provider’s inventory. Inclusive ranges must contain 12, 24, 36 or 48 months. Highest percentage wins; rules never stack. Equal rates use the smallest rule ID. Percentages: 0.01–100%. Selecting a provider is a demo context switch, not authentication.
discount.simpleIntro: Choose your provider, set a percentage and minimum lease length, then save.
discount.notSaved: No discount has been saved yet.
discount.savedOffer: Offer {percent}% off monthly net rent for leases of {months} months or longer.
discount.savedOff: Discount is off. Saved offer: {percent}% from {months} months.
discount.legacySaved: Existing discounts are preserved until you confirm a replacement.
discount.legacyWarning: These saved discounts cannot be represented by one minimum term without changing them. They remain unchanged unless you confirm replacement below.
discount.confirmReplacement: Replace the existing discounts with the setting below.
discount.offerMiddle: % off monthly net rent for leases of
discount.itemProvider: Offered by {name}. Discounts apply only to this provider’s items.

moderation.error: Could not save. Please try again.
moderation.stale: This review changed. Refresh and review the latest context before deciding.
moderation.forbidden: You need the moderator demo identity to view this page.
moderation.alreadyReported: You have already reported this revision.

profile.mockSigning: Demo signing: the application was approved by the server. This is a mock signature.
profile.documentUnavailable: The original document is unavailable. It has not been recreated from current prices.
